recipe.optimizer: existing fresh AdamW and clipping path from train_rnn.py; only two profile updates per mode; profile scheduler remains at the frozen one-cycle configuration
recipe.objective: the unchanged train_rnn WMSE distillation term plus aux_struct=0.3 and aux_next=0.3, using the validated source caches and full-sequence labels
recipe.profile_forward: same deterministic B16 first loader batch is reused for one compile/warmup update and one measured update; each update starts at sequence row 0 and forwards only rows 0:1000
limitations: This is a backend/profile smoke, not a fit-fidelity run: it performs two repeated first-chunk updates on 16 fitting sequences, not the full trajectory or one-cycle schedule horizon.
No validation, quality comparison, score, native serving claim, or fit result is produced.
A8 changes recurrent-boundary activations only; head activation A8 and native I16 projection are separate untested effects.

actual_data.subset_provenance: validated by the unchanged train_rnn component-subset and clean-fold readers; first batch order is seed-bound and emitted in PROFILE_BATCH_PROVENANCE
actual_data.input_reader: the frozen train_rnn SequenceFile, build_inputs, data loader and first causal window; no copied objective or cache reader
actual_data.teacher_cache: the unchanged validate_distillation_cache path; homogeneous main target, verified cache file hashes and metadata SHA emitted in PROFILE_RUN_PROVENANCE
actual_data.propensity_cache: the unchanged train_rnn propensity cache and sidecar validator; model checkpoint and sidecar SHA, path, rows and bytes emitted in PROFILE_RUN_PROVENANCE
actual_data.source_hashes: profile receipt carries trainer, activation backend, weight-QAT, GRU model, checkpoint, normalization, split, subset, teacher and propensity provenance hashes
actual_data.finite_domain: finite CP5 parameters/normalization checked before compile; actual input and carried FP32 state checked before every compiled chunk; finite update/loss/gradient evidence checked by the frozen trainer

comparison.initialization: separate trainer processes reload the same CP5 checkpoint and create fresh optimizers; deterministic seed/order and same first fitting batch
comparison.compiled_backend: both modes use torch.compile(fullgraph=True) around the same scan recurrence; compiler thread count 1 and physical cache required
comparison.update_integrity: receipt records optimizer/update evidence, finite losses/gradients/parameters, latent QAT tensor versions, cache invalidation, represented-weight fingerprints across consecutive forwards, compile timings and compile graph counters
comparison.cache_fingerprint_instrumentation: hashes small fixed-W4 represented weight tensors for the first two forwards; this bounded D2H check is included in the profile timing and must be identified when interpreting timings

cost_bound.note: The first 16 sequence batch is reused after the first optimizer update; only the first causal prefix is forwarded. Compiler and cgroup peaks must be admitted by root from live measurements before execution.

inductor_cache.runtime_behavior: wrapper requires TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR and rejects tmpfs/ramfs before trainer launch

execution: Root owns the physical memory/VRAM admission, GPU lock, command execution and terminal receipt collection. This actor performed static implementation checks only; no Torch test, compiler, native rebuild, or GPU run occurred.
